root_goal_boundary.immediate_branch: Test only whether natural Lambda*Lambda shifted-correlation estimates can be imported into CA4 by a mass-preserving algebraic decomposition.
root_goal_boundary.ceiling: A successful adapter would close only the stated CA4 sufficient input; CA4 plus LTRAD would still concern a small strip near Re(s)=1, not RH.

theorem_passport.architecture: QP/Turan positive-antenna branch; no Weil-side density conclusion is imported.
theorem_passport.source: Ordinary consecutive primes in [Y exp(-1/5),Y exp(1/5)]; natural comparison atoms are granted consecutive subintervals of this same shell.
theorem_passport.target_mask: The positive nodal-hat vector obtained after deleting both shares of each edge g>Y^(163/1000), followed by one normalization independent of t.
theorem_passport.comparison_mask: Natural factor weights proportional to Lambda(p) or Lambda(p)/sqrt(p) on consecutive prime subintervals; allowing all such subintervals is stronger than Alpoge--Furman HL*(4).
theorem_passport.coefficient_cone: Both positive and signed scalar decompositions are tested. Positive exact decompositions are tested first by rank; signed decompositions are charged by their scalar diagonal norm.
theorem_passport.normalization: Every prime-factor atom has total mass one. Its semiprime atom is the symmetrized product measure, with diagonal L2 size comparable to the product of the two prime l2 norms.
theorem_passport.quantifiers: Every sufficiently large legal Y and every translated dyadic T in the CA4 band. The decomposition is chosen before t and one common T-kernel is retained.
theorem_passport.resolution: Physical product resolution H=Y^2/T, including H=Y^(16/33) at T=Y^(50/33).
theorem_passport.sign: The signed translated kernel must remain common to the recombined form. Applying scalar estimates componentwise is explicitly charged by triangle/Minkowski; a joint estimate is classified as new vector-valued mathematics, not an adapter.
theorem_passport.target_exponent: The semiprime L2 norm must be at most T^(1/2) Y^(-q+1/20+o(1)), q=2787/3250, so a scalar diagonal-normalized recombination budget is Y^(-5249/6500+o(1)).
theorem_passport.downstream_adapter: Only a decomposition meeting that budget can feed CA4(163/1000,1/10).

candidate_statement.name: MSMT -- mass-preserving scalar mask transference
candidate_statement.definition: Decompose the hat semiprime coefficient matrix lambda lambda^T into a signed sum of symmetrized natural interval product atoms plus an l1-controlled residual, with the sum of absolute scalar coefficients times the atoms' diagonal l2 sizes bounded by Y^(-5249/6500+o(1)).
candidate_statement.generous_grant: Assume every natural interval or mixed-rectangle atom already has the ideal diagonal-scale translated fourth-moment bound. This is strictly stronger than the scalar global HL*(4) discussion in Alpoge--Furman.
candidate_statement.success_condition: Exact shell and mask, common translated kernel, exact H resolution, and scalar recombination norm within the target power budget.
candidate_statement.failure_scope: Failure refutes scalar natural-form transference, not CA4 itself and not a future joint selector-sensitive theorem.

fast_falsifiers.abstract: A positive sum of natural rank-one square atoms cannot equal the rank-one target unless every used atom is proportional to the hat vector.
fast_falsifiers.fejer: A nonnegative Fejer replacement controls absolute energy and cannot restore cancellations between signed decomposition components after scalar bounds are applied.
fast_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonode: Used only to test the variation mechanism; the actual theorem must use actual prime gaps and does so via PNT plus a primorial bound on long two-periodic gap runs.
fast_falsifiers.finite_evidence: Optional finite calculations may verify identities and constants but cannot establish the asymptotic variation lower bound.
fast_falsifiers.mass: The retained natural conductor range and every decomposition coefficient are charged in the diagonal norm; no small-modulus or short-interval range may be declared negligible without this ledger.

decision_rule.success: Produce an explicit decomposition and prove its scalar diagonal norm is within Y^(-5249/6500+o(1)).
decision_rule.failure: Prove a uniform lower bound on that atomic norm exceeding the power budget, or an exact cone/rank obstruction, while preserving shell and resolution.
decision_rule.stop: Do not call the failure a no-go for joint vector-valued masked HL estimates; those are a distinct open theorem.
